entries.title: Isaiah 62:1
segments: ¶For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp [that] burneth.

words.text: sake will I not hold my peace

entries.title: Isaiah 62:2
segments: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the LORD shall name.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:3
segments: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

words.text: Thou shalt also be a crown

entries.title: Isaiah 62:4
segments: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzibah, and thy land Beulah: for the LORD delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married. {Hephzibah: that is, My delight is in her} {Beulah: that is, Married}

words.text: Thou shalt no more be termed
. {Hephzibah: that is, My delight is in her} {Beulah: that is, Married}

entries.title: Isaiah 62:5
segments: For [as] a young man marrieth a virgin, [so] shall thy sons marry thee: and [as] the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, [so] shall thy God rejoice over thee. {as the...: Heb. with the joy of the bridegroom}

words.text: over thee. {as the...: Heb. with the joy of the bridegroom}

entries.title: Isaiah 62:6
segments: ¶I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, [which] shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence, {make...: or, are the LORD's remembrancers}

entries.title: Isaiah 62:7
segments: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth. {rest: Heb. silence}

entries.title: Isaiah 62:8
segments: The LORD hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn [to be] meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured: {Surely...: Heb. If I give, etc}

words.text: , for the which thou hast laboured

entries.title: Isaiah 62:9
segments: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the LORD; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.

words.text: ; and they that have brought it together

entries.title: Isaiah 62:10
segments: ¶Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:11
segments: Behold, the LORD hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward [is] with him, and his work before him. {work: or, recompence}

entries.title: Isaiah 62:12
segments: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the LORD: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.
